dictionary.seal-desc: Other devices need the 6-digit code shown on the server display.
dictionary.desc-step-1: Pick the interface and voice language. We compare this device's time zone with the server's.
dictionary.desc-step-2: We actually measure the room noise and your voice level to compute the signal-to-noise ratio. Optional step.
dictionary.desc-step-3: The name becomes the wake word. Record up to three takes: each one is analysed on the server.
dictionary.desc-step-4: Your name is used to recognise and greet you. Face photos are taken by the server camera.
dictionary.desc-step-5: We look for ONVIF cameras on the network and USB cameras plugged into the server. Only devices that really answer are listed.
dictionary.tz-mismatch: The two time zones differ: reminders and automations will use the server's.
dictionary.mic-banner-desc: First 3 seconds of silence, then speak normally for 4 seconds.
dictionary.mic-unavailable: The browser only allows the microphone on the server display or over HTTPS. You can skip this step.
dictionary.mic-denied: Microphone access denied by the browser.
dictionary.mic-good: Great: your voice stands out clearly from the noise.
dictionary.mic-ok: Acceptable: move closer or reduce noise for better results.
dictionary.mic-poor: Poor: your voice is too close to the noise. Repeat the measurement.
dictionary.assist-name: What should the assistant be called?
dictionary.wake-prompt: Press a circle and say “{name}”: we record 2 seconds.
dictionary.wake-need-name: Type a name first to record takes.
dictionary.wake-weak: too weak: move closer and retry
dictionary.wake-clipped: clipped: speak softer or step back
dictionary.face-desc: Stand in front of the server camera and press a view. Optional: you can also do it later from People & Presence.
dictionary.cam-none: No camera answered. You can add them later.
dictionary.brain-cloud-key: API key (kept in the encrypted vault)
dictionary.secret-kept: already set: leave empty to keep it
dictionary.launch-missing: The assistant or owner name is missing.
dictionary.code-desc: Enter the 6-digit code shown on the server display.
dictionary.err-start: Could not start the wizard: reload the page.
dictionary.err-assistant-name: The assistant name may contain only letters, spaces, apostrophes and hyphens.
dictionary.err-owner-name: Type your first name: letters and hyphens only, no spaces.
dictionary.err-name-conflict: Your name cannot match the assistant's name.
dictionary.err-cloud: Pick the cloud service and enter the API key.
dictionary.err-ha: Home Assistant needs a valid address and token.
dictionary.desc-step-6: Pick one or more purposes: Nuxiva prepares the right features. Nothing sensitive turns on without your consent in the next step.
dictionary.desc-step-7: For every feature that touches personal data I ask for a yes or a no. Until you answer, the feature stays off.
dictionary.desc-step-8: We read the server's real hardware and suggest a suitable model. You can also use another computer or a cloud service.
dictionary.desc-step-9: Check your choices: on launch they are written to the configuration and the wizard closes.
dictionary.purpose-home-sub: Automations, habits, voice and a digital twin of the home.
dictionary.purpose-work-sub: Build sites and apps, projects, agents and experts, online research.
dictionary.purpose-family-sub: Voice for everyone, music, games, sports and recognising people.
dictionary.purpose-knowledge-sub: Experts in every subject, research on real sources, skills.
dictionary.purposes-none: No purpose chosen: you will set up features from the panel.
dictionary.consent-faces-sub: Uses the webcam to tell who is home. Photos stay on the server.
dictionary.consent-voiceprint-sub: Answers only registered voices and ignores TV and strangers.
dictionary.consent-listening-sub: The microphone listens locally until it hears the assistant's name.
dictionary.consent-cameras-sub: Live view and motion alerts. Recording stays off and needs separate consent.
dictionary.consent-web_research-sub: Current questions are checked on real sources, without personal data.
dictionary.consent-location-sub: Weather and local services via Wi-Fi or network. If you refuse, only the location you set is used.
dictionary.consent-code_run-sub: Tests and trials isolated, offline, and always after your confirmation.
dictionary.consent-auto_experts-sub: A question with no specialist creates a new expert (at most 8 a day).
dictionary.consent-network_guard-sub: The firewall inspects home network packets to spot attacks.
